text: A day now lasts about an hour and a half.
At an hour and a half you are almost weightless, about one eighth of your weight: a hundred and fifty pounds becomes about eighteen.
A foot-and-a-half jump carries you about thirteen feet, higher than a basketball hoop, and a cup falling off a table takes about three times as long to land.
The Sun crosses the whole sky in forty-five minutes.
One more nudge, and something changes completely.
